description: Erection of first floor extension to create a two storey house, part single storey and part two storey rear extension, removal of a front porch, addition of a front canopy, together with associated changes to the existing house layout and internal alterations to the existing bungalow
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ND/HR/01, ND/HR/02, ND/HR/04, ND/HR/05, ND/HR/06, ND/HR/07, ND/HR/08, ND/HR/09, ND/HR/10, ND/HR/11, ND/HR/12, ND/HR/13 - received 9th August 2021.
Planning/Design & Access Statement - received 23rd August 2021.
ND/HR/05 Rev. A, ND/HR/07 Rev. A, ND/HR/08 Rev. A - received 27th September 2021.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, the two cycle storage spaces as shown on the approved plans shall be provided for the future occupiers and maintained thereafter.
Reason: To ensure the adequate provision of secure cycle parking for future occupiers in accordance with Local Plan policy EC2.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The sections of the existing bungalow to be retained as shown on drawings ND/HR/05 Rev. A, ND/HR/07 Rev. A, ND/HR/08 Rev. A - received 27th September 2021, shall be retained and not demolished.
Reason: To ensure that the development does not amount to a demolition and rebuild as this would invalidate this householder planning permission.
